work.title: Untitled (Grid with Roundels)
work.description: Horizontal relief panel constructed from white layered elements arranged in an irregular grid pattern of vertical and horizontal dark bars. Scattered across the surface are small circular disc-like roundels with floral or iridescent centers, bisected vertically by a dark central spine.
work.composition: horizontal relief bisected by central vertical spine
keywords: irregular bar grid with disc inlays
